name: qa_global
title: OS-FINALQA, Global (OS-303PERF): the module instruments' own measure on the unit: `diag mod` per instance (state and hot code placement; render alone against the whole instance loop, min / mean / max), `diag bench tb303` at 64 and 128 frames, and `diag cpu perf off`. Captures the readings in the log; the figures are the unit's, they are not pass / fail limits. Writes nothing to the card. Leaves the measure OFF

steps.say: OS-303PERF, rows QA-GLB-001..007 of docs/qa/catalogue/global.md (a unit step is named by the row id its note begins with). For the figures of cpu-budget section 6 (the module render without USB traffic) the unit SHOULD present STANDARD before the run: Config > USB, USB AUDIO Off, F7 twice, from the unit (the second F7 re-enumerates the port and the console goes with it: o3hil cannot do that part). The check is soft, as in the README protocol (platform/mk66/README.md): in AUDIO the run still captures the placement lines, but its maxima carry the isochronous interrupts and are not a baseline: say so in the report. The console stays on the CDC serial port in STANDARD; nothing here changes the mode. The held note is measured for 8 s (it sounds about 17 s; a song would be 60 s: not this scenario)
